Both changes are saved; the API accepted the write and reading the document back confirms them.

- **Main colour:** the portal is in assisted colour mode, so I set the primary colour in `theme.assistedModeColors` to `#1B5E20`, a dark green. The secondary and accent colours are unchanged. The other palettes and text colours will be recalculated from this when the draft is saved, as the portal's configuration notes describe. I did not switch off assisted mode.
- **Menu:** I added "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (slug `jeunesse`, from the portal's list of free pages) as a "Page libre" item after the existing Home and Catalogue de données entries. I left the label empty, so the menu shows the page's own title.

I did not check the rendered site, so I can't confirm the exact green as it will appear on screen.
